author: reek
body: `probe` declares NO effect row at all. Its body performs Store.Read and Store.Write, and a single `with Store` handler discharges both by the dotted sub-effect lattice -- the same effect-covered-by relation the def boundary already uses to accept [Store.Read] against a declared [Store]. If discharge did not reach dotted members, the two labels would survive into probe's ambient row and the def boundary would reject the pure signature with CDX2031; the let-binding would also trip CDX2033. So a green run here is the discharge, not a coincidence.
